transcript.text: Can you be friends with your employees?
So, when I started I was friends with
all my employees. Whatever the
professional line was, I definitely
didn't have it. I would show my emotions
on my sleeves. If I was upset, they
would be upset. I'd take my emotions out
on them. When I needed them to change
something, it was weird because we're
friends. I'm like, "Hey man, can you,
you know, like it just was it sucked." I
would say that where I'm at now in my
career is that you can be friends with
your employees as long as you maintain a
clear line. And the easiest way that I
have delineated this is literally doing
a hat change. I'll start a conversation
be like, "friend hat." And then I'll
talk whatever I'm going to talk. And
sometimes I'm like, "Hey man, boss hat.
Like this is this is what's going wrong.
Like you need to change this." So, it's
just maintaining that line.
